notes: Two subscription tiers. UseAlibi covers teleport, trip mode, USB, saved places and history; UseAlibi + Phone adds Wi-Fi and control from anywhere. The app reads your tier from your account and locks the Plus features with an upgrade prompt if your plan does not include them, and a + Phone trial gets them for the full 3 days. Also fixed: an ended subscription could still change your location. The macOS build is Apple Silicon only (M1 or newer).
